name: Alpenglow
summary: Replaces TowerBFT and Proof of History voting with Votor and Rotor, targeting finality in roughly 100-150ms instead of ~12s.
why_it_matters: Sub-second finality changes what is buildable on-chain: payments and orderbook trading stop needing off-chain confirmation layers.

name: SIMD-0525
summary: Tracked in the SIMD repository. Check the linked repo for the current stage — SIMDs move between draft, review, accepted and activated.
why_it_matters: SIMDs are where protocol-level economics and validator requirements are decided before they reach mainnet.

name: Firedancer
summary: A second full validator implementation written from scratch by Jump Crypto, running alongside Agave.
why_it_matters: Client diversity is the single biggest structural risk reducer for a chain: one implementation bug can no longer halt the network.

name: Token Extensions (Token-2022)
summary: Adds transfer hooks, confidential transfers, interest-bearing tokens and metadata directly at the token program level.
why_it_matters: Compliance features at the protocol layer are what institutional and RWA issuers have been waiting for.
